name: Draw Me! 🎨
desc:
Get drawn by your friends, vote for the best drawing! 
Spend the coins you earn on poses, cosmetics, and more!

⚠️ Inappropriate artwork is not tolerated, and will likely result in a permanent ban. Press the RED FLAG BUTTON 🚩 to send the drawings to us to review. Please be respectful and keep Roblox safe for everyone!

Controls 🕹️ 1 to 7 are all assigned to a specific tool!

⬅️ Undo: Ctrl + Z
➡️ Redo: Ctrl + Y

❤️ Like Draw Me! 🎨? Leave a 👍 and ⭐ to show your support!
⭐ FUN UPDATE AT 200,000 LIKES!

We support all keyboard & touch devices 🎮
